model_reported.name: conduire-experience-optimisation
model_reported.summary: Kept the serial kernel for small work and added two explicit static row-sharing variants, selected by the requested thread budget.

model_reported.name: inspecter-environnement
model_reported.summary: No hardware- or compiler-specific transformation was chosen; the code uses the supplied thread budget directly.

model_reported.name: consulter-documentation-technique
model_reported.summary: Used basic OpenMP parallel/for constructs already present in the source, without relying on version-specific APIs or claims.

model_reported.name: evaluer-performances
model_reported.summary: Reported the available serial baseline and deferred correctness and one-/four-core timing comparisons to the controller.

proposal.hypothesis: For small active grids, the original serial path avoids OpenMP startup. For larger work, a one-thread budget uses a region per timestep to expose its six-region overhead against the serial baseline, while larger budgets keep one team across all timesteps to limit startup cost and test static row-level scaling. The output math and boundary writes remain unchanged; the controller must measure and verify both paths.

retained: Preserved the serial stencil and output initialization; route small active workloads through the serial implementation.
Added a shared row kernel and static OpenMP work sharing over collapsed z/y row loops.
Use a separate parallel region per timestep for larger one-thread calls and a persistent team across all six timesteps for multi-thread calls, with num_threads set from the call budget.
